                ρ.SameOrbit η ↔ ∃ (F : VertexSpace k d ≃ₗ[k] VertexSpace k d), ∀ (r : R) (z : VertexSpace k d), F ((↑ρ r) z) = (↑η r) (F z)

                A change of basis intertwining the actions necessarily preserves the vertex decomposition. Evaluating the intertwining equation on each vertex idempotent recovers its diagonal blocks.
